hook.name: TribunalHook
hook.description: Implements sell-tax and protocol fee mechanics on TRIB/WETH swaps via afterSwap with delta return. On sells (TRIB→WETH), deducts a personal sell tax (up to 8%, reduced by stake percentage via Court contract) plus a 1% protocol fee in WETH, sent to staker rewards and treasury respectively. On buys (WETH→TRIB), deducts a 1% protocol fee in TRIB to treasury.
